summary: Iteration 11 tested both backend and frontend against requested sync checks. Backend proxy/API tests passed (including PDF import failure paths). Frontend mobile web flow passed onboarding, tabs, settings->plans->back, and import screen no-document baseline without runtime crash.

integration_issues.issue: Task card tap is interactive and app remains stable, but web automation could not read deterministic checkbox state via aria-checked (returned null), limiting strict automated verification semantics.

issues: active-plan-switcher touch target appears below 44px minimum (minHeight: 30), which is low for mobile accessibility.

action_items: Optionally expose deterministic task completion state for web E2E (e.g., explicit testID/state label) to strengthen automation assertions.
Increase active-plan-switcher touch target to >=44px for mobile accessibility.
Align env naming guidance and runtime usage (EXPO_BACKEND_URL vs EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) to avoid cross-agent config drift.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/plans/import-pdf handles missing file and non-PDF types correctly (422/400) and root proxy /api/ returns expected payload.
Frontend import API relies on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback; app.json extra.backendUrl is not populated, so env naming consistency is important.
No React Native red-screen/runtime crash observed during requested core flows in web preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not re-loop on DocumentPicker automation here; requested no-document state and API failure paths are already validated. If deeper task-toggle semantics are required, add explicit UI state test hook/testID for completion status.
rca_of_issue: No backend defects found. Remaining frontend gap is testability/semantics: task completion toggles via Pressable but automation could not reliably introspect checkbox state through aria-checked on web preview. Mitigation: expose explicit completion-state test marker (e.g., testID or visible status text) per task row.
test_credentials: Required credentials file /app/memory/test_credentials.md is missing in this workspace; no auth flows were in scope.
